_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking and saving the draft order

description: Saves a draft of the order (the logo from check_logo, the card message, the sign-off, the occasion and the kind of gift) and returns a private link. The customer opens the link to check the preview and every card, add their recipient list and pay on the website. Takes no recipient names or addresses and no payment details. Each call saves a new draft with its own link. The answer says when the link expires.

boxes.description: Optional estimate of how many boxes; the recipient list sets the real count.

card_message.description: The message printed on every card. get_gift_box_details gives the rules.

logo_ref.description: From check_logo. Leave it out and the customer adds the logo on the website.

mode.description: business for a company logo, personal for a personal gift.

occasion.description: The occasion, as get_gift_box_details names them.

signed_by.description: Who the cards are from, printed under the message.

name: create_draft_order

card.description: The card as it will print.

note.description: How the first-name field is filled, when the message uses it.

draft_url.description: The private link where the customer finishes the order.

estimate.description: The box estimate and its total; the recipient list sets the real count.

expires.description: The last day the link works.

logo_stored.description: Whether the draft holds the logo; if not, the customer adds it on the website.

notes.description: The answer's other notes, each a line of its text word for word: that this is a new link, or why the box estimate was left out.

seal.description: The seal sticker on the gift box's lid.

product.description: Our own gift box: its name and its photo.

title: Create a draft order
